items.Description: This book provides a detailed breakdown of Asander's accounts. It would seem that the vast majority of the corrupt noble's wealth has come from illicit activity. Narcotics smuggling accounts for a significant percentage of the income, but the most profitable venture Asander was …

items.Name: Amulet of Souls
items.Description:
This amulet once belonged to a vampire named Valen who dwelt in the ruins of Shoonach, far to the south. A powerful necromancer, Valen discovered a method of nullifying the deadly rays of the sun. 

Every time he trapped a human soul within the large ruby contained within this a…

items.Name: Ancient Coin
items.Description: This ancient coin is made of some non-ferrous metal that resembles gold. On both sides is the visage of a sphinx, the famed monster of the desert.

items.Name: Belm Plant
items.Description: These plants, native almost exclusively to Tethyr, are known for their medicinal properties. The application of the crushed-plant on to an open wound is said to ease pain and increase the rate of healing.

items.Name: Blackwood Staff
items.Description:
Neremul's staff is a masterpiece of its kind, incredibly smooth yet as strong as folded steel. At a command, the end of the stave drips corrosive acid which can burn through flesh and bone alike.

Neremul would never part with this staff and would likely toast anyone or anything…

items.Description: This is a simple bronze key.

items.Name: Chauntean Robe
items.Description: These simple woollen robes are worn by the clergy of Chauntea.

items.Name: Cloak of the Wolfborn
items.Description: This cloak, made from the hide of a greater wolfwere, grants the wearer considerable resistance to damage from weapons without powerful magic. In addition, it grants the wearer regeneration powers approaching those of a troll. The regeneration does not extend as far as healing a…

items.Name: Asander's Tunic
items.Description: These garments are extremely well-made. Obviously a paranoid man, Lord Asander has also had them enchanted to provide him with no small amount of protection from physical attacks.

items.Name: Crackletongue
items.Description: This mighty sword once belong to Queen Zaranda Star of Tethyr. Incredibly sharp, Crackletongue is constantly alight with magical blue flames. The sword detects the presence of evil, and its flames splutter and crackle in relation to the intensity and proximity of the evil.

items.Name: Dagger of the Tauran
items.Description: The horned blade of dagger is ragged, tearing flesh as readily as it pierces. Minotaurs are known to be highly resistant to mind-affecting magic, perhaps due to the blind rage that drives them. This dagger seems to impart a small portion of that resistance to the wielder.

items.Name: Death Longsword
items.Description: This sword was rumored to be the downfall of many an adventurer in Baldur's Gate foolishly attempting to get one over on the Shadow Thieves. Though its former master is now dead, the blade retains its sickening hunger for human lblood.
PropertiesDecoded: Human Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1d6 Damage

items.Description: Blood from the dead dragon, Verminanthrax.

items.Description: A simple golden key.

items.Name: Greater Wolfwere Pelt
items.Description: This is the pelt of a dead greater wolfwere.

items.Name: Guild Tower Key
items.Description: This is the key given to you by Cassana. It should unlock the door leading to the upper floors of the Mages' Guild tower.

items.Name: Illithid Cell Key
items.Description: This key looks like it would fit the locks on the cell doors in the strange lair beneath the sewers.

items.Name: Inferno
items.Description: This bastard sword is literally ablaze with flame. The sheer heat generated by the blade puts even its more famous cousin the Firebrand to shame. That Kazdag managed to wield Inferno without dropping it or burning himself alive is a testament to his bravery, strength, and stupid…

items.Name: Lesser Ioun Stone: Blue
items.Description: Ioun stones are well known to possess different powers depending upon their color.  When activated they orbit around the head of their owner.  Only 1 lesser ioun stone may be activated at a time. The blue ioun stone increases your wisdom by 2 while active.

items.Description: Founded in distant Thay, the Monastic Order of the Long Death celebrates the passage from life to lifelessness in all of its forms. items.Description: Armor made from mithral is very light and has a reduced chance of arcane spell failure compared to standard armor of the same type.

items.Description: Mynseril Lostbone was a powerful priest of Malar who enjoyed many a bloody brawl or battle, but felt that such fights were simply over too soon. items.Name: Lightning's Edge
items.Description: These wicked spears are given to Talos' most trusted priests. Shaped like a lightning bolt, they possess a powerful enchantment that channels electricity into the body of whomever is unfortunate enough to be skewered on its tip.

items.Name: Malthus' Key
items.Description: This key was found on the body of the paladin Malthus de Tigana.

items.Name: Arrk's Greatsword
items.Description:
Arrk's massive sword is too large to be wielded by any creature of less than troll size. The wicked blade is covered in gore and constantly drips blood, an odd side effect of the sword's ability to inflict wounds that bleed for an abnormal period of time.

Unfortunately, the swo…

items.Name: Jeweler's Guarantee
items.Description: This seems to be a written guarantee for an amulet. Looking at the figures involved, the amulet must have been very expensive. The jeweler in question is one Errol Punto, 'Supplying the Finest Wares in the Caravan Quarter for Twenty Years,' as the guarantee so confidently states.

items.Name: Tethyr: A Geographical Overview
items.Description:
Tethyr is one of the largest of Faerun's realms. Much of this vast expanse of plains and forests is settled only sparsely.

An old, often fragmented land, Tethyr is dry and hot yet also fertile. Farms dot the country, and in the north the ancient and formidable Wealdath forest h…

items.Name: Key to Noble's Mansion
items.Description: This is the key that Darklun Kade gave you. It should unlock one of the doors leading into the noble's mansion in the Royal Quarter.

items.Name: Guard Captain's Key
items.Description: This key was found on the body of the guard captain in the noble's mansion.

items.Name: Assassin's Note
items.Description:
This note is covered in beautiful, flowing script.

"The one who must die is due to return soon. Be careful, for the rumors indicate they will be no easy mark. If you fail, you risk endangering us all. The death of this so-called hero will send a message to Queen Ellesime that s…

items.Description: This key should unlock the cells in Asander's estate.

items.Name: Darklun's Key
items.Description: This key belonged to Darklun, leader of the Shadow Thieves in Darromar.

items.Description: The Warden's Key.

This list describes several powerful items which Garfindel believes he could create with the right components. It would be worth hanging on to these strange materials should you chance to come across them in your adventures.

items.Description: This key was found on the body of the ranger, Jordwyn.

items.Name: Wererat's Note
items.Description: "Sewers no safe-safe. Big brain eater scares ratkin, makes humans mad-crazy. We flee to Shadowdale, find friend-brother Ratoboi. He got big smarts."

items.Name: Gamalon Idogyr, Count of Spellshire
items.Description:
This book is a biographical account of Gamalon Idogyr, Court Sage of Tethyr and a powerful archmage known for his knowledge of spelljamming magic - the use of vessels to explore wildspace and the other worlds of the Prime Material Plane.

"Much of Gamalon's family, including his…

items.Name: Volo's Bestiaries: The Malaugrym
items.Description: The foul malaugrym were until recently thought to be the corrupt and tainted offspring of the wizard Malaug, reputedly the first human to explore the Plane of Shadow, preceding even the Netherese. However, that theory may have been incorrect, for the vile clan of shapeshifting c…

items.Name: Key to Great Library
items.Description: This is the key to the Great Library of Faerntarn Palace, found on the body of Officer Reddy.

items.Name: Kingscar
items.Description: This mighty weapon was until recently wielded by the ogre warlord Sythillis. In the hands a powerful warrior, it could cut down entire ranks of Tethyrian soldiers.

items.Description: These suits are replicas of the armor worn by the Avatar of Callarduran Smoothand, and thus bear his name. Craftsmen of the svirfneblin, the deep gnomes, created these suits to honor this god of stone. Once donned, the armor gives its owner extraordinary resistance to magic. The…

items.Description: The famed "Maul of the Titans" is as large as the average half-orc and only those of titanic size and strength would have any hope of wielding it successfully.

items.Name: White Robe of the Archmagi
items.Description: Most items of this type bear markings associated with one or more deities of good and order. Likely these are an attempt to encourage moral behavior among spellcasters, rewarding those who manage their power in responsible ways instead of lording their ability over others.

items.Name: Black Robe of the Archmagi
items.Description: Like many evil items, these robes are fashioned in great numbers by the Zhentarim and their minions. They are found far and wide across the Realms, and the more hands they touch, the more influence the Zhents enjoy.

items.Name: Solar Armour
items.Description: Made from a fine silk, this robe seems to have a permanent aura of light around it.

items.Name: Ilyana's Robe
items.Description: Former Royal Magician Vangerdahast to King Azoun IV of Cormyr was once an accomplished adventurer of high fame. One reason he became popular in wizardly circles was his creation of the Adventurer's Robe. Mages have always struggled with the limitations placed on them by the abil…

items.Description: Sick to death of hearing about the prowess of mages like Elminster, Blackstaff, and the Red Wizards of Thay; Klaphen Fortier, a powerful, but relatively unknown wizard, created these robes to bolster young spellcasters across the realms. His hope was that youthful and unscrupulo…

items.Name: Message to Garret
items.Description:
"Keep up the good work, Garret. Remember to stay away from those red-cloaked mercenaries, however. Orvel and his boys tried mugging one a few days back and received a sound beating. Orvel barely escaped with his life.
 
Ah, 'tis a grand time to be a Shadow Thief, no doubt about …

items.Name: Minor Ring of Regeneration
items.Description: This ring is a lesser cousin of the fabled Ring of Regeneration. Its power is still great indeed, as it allows the bearer to heal at a spectacular rate. This ring explains how Creep was able to survive for so long in Darromar's dangerous sewer network.

items.Name: Minotaur Horn
items.Description: This horn belonged to the minotaur Fulgore.

items.Name: Mountain Crusher
items.Description: This huge club is too large for all but the strongest of humanoids to wield. Gnarled like an old oak tree, the club strikes with seismic force and can knock a small dragon to the ground with a single blow.

items.Name: Nightblade
items.Description: A variant on the more powerful Nyskar's Nightblade found in Thay, this cruel longsword is enchanted to inflict greater damage against those of pure spirit. Alas, such beings find the abhorrent nature of this blade means it is impossible for them to wield.

However, we require your ranger instincts. I sense great evil, and it seems to have corrupted the minds of the…

items.Name: Note to Slagar
items.Description:
This note is rather grimy, and covered in the blood of the slaver, Slagar. You can still make out most of the words.

"My dear Slagar,

I shall have another ship's worth of slaves ready for you shortly. Tell your master that I apologize for the poor quality of this latest batch.…

items.Name: Kevendred's Note
items.Description:
Ah, what a shame. The chest is empty. Better luck next time.

                                               - K

items.Name: Note from Ellesime
items.Description:
This hastily scribbled note is still wet with ink.

"The palace is under attack. I am trapped here in the throne room.

To the one who reads this, I implore you: do not raise the alarm. I am certain the Ventinari family is behind this. Only they have the resources to attempt to …

items.Name: Ornate Spoon
items.Description: This spoon has an intricate design etched onto its surface. Likely made of silver, it would fetch a fair price if sold to the right buyer.

items.Name: Pass to the Broken Realm
items.Description: This is a hastily written pass signed by the High Mage of Suldanessellar, Talamar. It gives express permission for you to enter the Broken Realm east of the Underland. You should show this to the one called "The Warden," who guards the gate.

items.Name: Pendant of Dragonkind
items.Description: The crystallized blood of a dead dragon hangs from this pendant. The wearer is granted some of the innate power and strength of dragonkind itself, becoming quicker, healthier, and wiser. The wearer of the pendant no longer feels fear, and once a day can call upon the battle rage…

items.Name: Portrait
items.Description: A small portrait of a beautiful princess.

items.Name: Purefire
items.Description: Forged by the dwarven smith Gregor Fherum for his halfling friend and former adventuring partner, Titus Goldfinger, this short sword was put to regular use when the two companions used to travel together. Alas, when they finally retired from the profession, Titus lived up to his…

items.Name: Rainbow Blade
items.Description: This strange blade has myriad colors swirling within in, a side effect of the three elemental powers that infuse the sword. The odd pattern is quite seductive to look at and enemies risk becoming dazed when confronted with weapon.

items.Name: Rapier of Dancing
items.Description: This remarkable rapier has the ability to take on a life of its own for a short time, leaping back and forth to defend the wielder and strike at the enemy of its own accord. The blade is exceptionally skilful, in effect increasing the number of attacks the wielder can make.

items.Name: Recall Scroll
items.Description: This scroll can be activated only once Maresh is dead. It will teleport you and your companions directly back to the Underland.

items.Name: Ring of the Tyrant
items.Description:
This ring is wrought from platinum and inlaid with two sapphires. For all  of its material worth, the ring's true value lies in its ability to bend the mind of an individual to the wearer's will.

The ring seemingly only has one charge remaining.
PropertiesDecoded: Dominate Person (7) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Rivercrest
items.Description: Rivercrest is an extremely rare plant that grows only by large bodies of freshwater. Old wives' tales claim that it has medicinal properties, though they mysteriously refuse to elaborate on exactly what these are.

items.Name: Rod of Revival
items.Description: This rod is a treasure gained during your previous adventures. Its power is great, for it allows the wielder to pull a recently fallen companion back from the brink of death. Although you haven't had the chance to put it to much use so far, it should certainly come in handy in t…
PropertiesDecoded: Raise Dead (9) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Note from a Fence
items.Description:
This hastily written note reads:

"Meet me at the arranged spot. As always, I pay a premium for magical goods - but if you can obtain anything else of value, I can give you a good price. 

Remember, be careful. I don't want you getting caught red-handed plundering the Guild, in …

items.Name: Silver Key
items.Description: This is a plain silver key.

items.Name: Slaver Robe
items.Description: This garment is faintly enchanted so that swords, daggers, and other edged weapons have a tendency to become caught in the folds of fabric upon striking, causing less damage to the wearer of the robe.

items.Name: Brief Note
items.Description: For emergencies.

items.Name: Snakebite
items.Description: This whip secretes a small amount of acid from the barbed end. Though not poisonous, the acid burns through cloth and flesh with ease.

items.Name: Talamar's Spell Component
items.Description: This is the spell component that Elhan asked you to deliver to High Mage Talamar. It appears to be the canine of some large beast, but you can't be certain exactly which.

items.Name: Strange Crystal
items.Description: This crystal seems to glow from within, lit by an unearthy purple light. Strangely, however, it radiates no magic.

items.Name: Talite Robe
items.Description: These robes are worn by the clergy of the deity of destruction, Talos.

items.Name: Temple Key
items.Description: This large key must open one of the doors in the temple of Gruumsh.

items.Name: A Recent History of Tethyr I: The Interregnum
items.Description:
The blackest period in Tethyr's recent history is now referred to as the Alemandrain Interregnum, or simply the Interregnum.

On the 12th day of Eleint, 1347, disaster struck. Castle Tethyr was burned to the ground, killing the entire Royal Family.

items.Name: The Plane of Shadow
items.Description: It is the toxic plane of darkness and power. It is the hidden place that hates the light. It is the frontier of worlds unknown. The Plane of Shadow is a darkly lighted dimension that is both coterminous to and coexistent with the Material Plane. It overlaps the Material Plane mu…

items.Name: A Recent History of Tethyr II: The Reclamation Wars
items.Description:
After two decades of suffering and strife, the people of Tethyr called out for change and peace. The Reclamation Wars lasted as a military campaign for two years, but are tied up in events spanning almost three years.

As the adventuress Zaranda Star gained repute for her deeds …

items.Name: A Recent History of Tethyr III: The Tribunal
items.Description: Of the seventeen noble prisoners collected during the months of the Reclamation War, all were tried to determine the exact crimes that were committed against Tethyr. While the accused were granted one day of leniency to argue for mercy, each and every one of them was convicted a…

items.Name: Vampiric Dagger
items.Description: This foul weapon glows with a hellish aura. The serrated edge appears carefully designed to cut through flesh with ease.

items.Name: Ventinari Estate Key
items.Description: This is a key to the Ventinari estate.

items.Name: Fire Arrow
items.Description: Fire Arrows burst into flames when fired, with an effect almost identical to a nonmagical arrow doused in oil and set alight.

items.Name: Spider Rider Arrow
items.Description: A sticky yellow substance coats the head of the missile. It is said missiles such as these sap the strength from the muscles of those struck by it.

items.Name: Mild Poison Bolt
items.Description: A sticky yellow substance coats the head of this missile. It is said missiles such as these sap the strength from the muscles of those struck by them.

items.Name: Unholy Bloodfeeding Battleaxe +2
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.
PropertiesDecoded: Good Damage Bonus vs. Alignment Group 1d4 Damage

items.Name: Blue Lightning
items.Description: The magical, lightning arrows fired from this huge bow strike with the force of thunder.
